rule: A witness domain is not counted toward the line when it is one of these domains or a subdomain of one, or a GitHub account listed here. A witness whose operator_name is the name of an officer, an employee or a member store of the operator or of Yakumo is not counted either, whatever its domain; that is checked by hand in the day's witness table.
note: Domains are self-declared; we have not verified who operates them.
